tara (product): quick quarterly checkpoint — sharing ship matrix and CR queue. TL;DR: three green, two slipped, deps with infra. Full list below.
eli (eng): thanks. dropping current status.
eli (eng): shipped: model-serving v2 (PR #4821) — merged, canary 50% today.
michelle (eng-runtime): noted — runtime perf tests passed on p3; will watch latency dashboards.
juan (eng-platform): slipped: autoscaler rollout — blocked on node-image CVE patch from infra. assigned to @nora.
nora (sre): looking into the CVE, ETA patch/rebuild EOD tomorrow.
ryan (eng): CR pings: please review PRs: #4950 (batching), #4962 (kv-cache fix). low-risk; want merge before EOW.
tara (product): owners: eli -> model-serving, michelle -> runtime, juan -> autoscale infra, ryan -> batching.
ci-bot: CI summary: #4821 ✅, #4950 ⏳ failing flaky test (integration/flaky_io), #4962 ⏳ pending review.
eli (eng): @ryan i'll take a look at #4950 now.
ryan (eng): thanks @eli — leaving small comment on line 87 re: backoff logic.
michelle (eng-runtime): for runtime -> runbook update needed if latency breach during canary. I'll add a mini-runbook PR after merge.
tara (product): next steps: 1) @nora confirm CVE rebuild timeline, 2) @eli + @michelle monitor canary, 3) @ryan get CR merges in. Flag remaining slips by EOD.
juan (eng-platform): FYI there's a dep on storage upgrade — will schedule a short patch window Thu 10-11am. please note.
eli (eng): acked. I'll pause non-critical rollouts that hit that storage cluster.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: model-serving v2 canary -> prod-50% at 2026-03-21T14:00Z
tara (product): thanks all. If no major flags, i'll compile this into the Q2 sync note. :thumbsup: 
ryan (eng): quick Q — any requests for canary metrics besides latency/error rate? i'd add p95 token latency and CPU util per GPU.
tara (product): yes @ryan add p95 and per-route error count. good call.
eli (eng): final: PR checklist: test coverage + perf run log + rollback steps. ping here when merged.
nora (sre): CVE rebuild started, ETA 6 hours. will post image id here when done.
ci-bot: nightly e2e results posted: https://ci.example.com/builds/12345
tara (product): perfect. I'll mark ship matrix row statuses and follow up in async OKR doc. thanks everyone.
